entries.name: ALL_PROXY
entries.description: A URL to proxy both unencrypted and encrypted HTTP requests through. When set, n8n uses this value when more specific variables (HTTP_PROXY or HTTPS_PROXY) aren't present.

entries.name: CODE_ENABLE_STDOUT
entries.description: Set to true to send Code node logs from console.log or print to the process's stdout, only for production executions.

entries.name: CREDENTIALS_DEFAULT_NAME
entries.description: The default name for credentials.

entries.name: CREDENTIALS_OVERWRITE_ENDPOINT
entries.description: The API endpoint to fetch credentials.

entries.name: CREDENTIALS_OVERWRITE_PERSISTENCE
entries.description: Enable database persistence for credential overwrites. Required for multi-instance or queue mode to propagate overwrites to workers through a publish/subscribe approach.

entries.name: DB_CONNECTION_ACQUISITION_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: How long, in milliseconds, a query waits while recovery is in progress before failing fast with an error. Set to 0 to wait indefinitely. Applies to PostgreSQL only.

entries.name: DB_LOGGING_ENABLED
entries.description: Whether to enable database-specific logging.

entries.name: DB_LOGGING_MAX_EXECUTION_TIME
entries.description: Maximum execution time (in milliseconds) before n8n logs a warning. Set to 0 to disable long running query warning.

entries.name: DB_LOGGING_OPTIONS
entries.type: Enum string: query, error, schema, warn, info, log
entries.description: Database log output level. To enable all logging, specify all. Refer to TypeORM logging options

entries.name: DB_PING_INTERVAL_SECONDS
entries.description: How often, in seconds, n8n pings the database to check that the connection is still alive.

entries.name: DB_PING_MAX_FAILURES_BEFORE_RECOVERY
entries.description: How many pings in a row must fail before n8n treats the connection as lost and starts recovery.

entries.name: DB_PING_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: How long, in milliseconds, n8n waits for a single ping to respond before counting it as a failure. Falls back to N8N_DB_PING_TIMEOUT, deprecated from n8n 2.35.0, if that's set.

entries.name: DB_RECOVERY_BACKOFF_MAX_MS
entries.description: The longest, in milliseconds, n8n waits between recovery attempts. This caps the backoff. Must be greater than or equal to DB_RECOVERY_BACKOFF_MIN_MS.

entries.name: DB_RECOVERY_BACKOFF_MIN_MS
entries.description: How long, in milliseconds, n8n waits before its first recovery attempt. Each retry waits longer (exponential backoff).

entries.name: DB_SQLITE_POOL_SIZE
entries.description: The number of parallel SQL read connections in the SQLite connection pool. Must be at least 1. Setting it to 0 logs a warning and falls back to the default. n8n opens the SQLite file in WAL mode.

entries.name: DB_SQLITE_VACUUM_ON_STARTUP
entries.description: Runs VACUUM operation on startup to rebuild the database. Reduces file size and optimizes indexes. This is a long running blocking operation and increases start-up time.

entries.name: DB_TABLE_PREFIX
entries.description: Prefix to use for table names.

entries.name: EXECUTIONS_DATA_HARD_DELETE_BUFFER
entries.description: How old (hours) the finished execution data has to be to get hard-deleted. By default, this buffer excludes recent executions as the user may need them while building a workflow.

entries.name: EXECUTIONS_DATA_MAX_AGE
entries.description: The execution age (in hours) before it's deleted.

entries.name: EXECUTIONS_DATA_MAX_DISPLAY_SIZE
entries.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of execution data that n8n loads when displaying an execution (editor, execution detail, and public API). For larger executions, n8n omits the data (shown as "too large to display") to avoid running low-resource instances out of memory. Doesn't affect retrying or resuming exe

entries.name: EXECUTIONS_DATA_PRUNE
entries.description: Whether to delete data of past executions on a rolling basis.

entries.name: EXECUTIONS_DATA_PRUNE_HARD_DELETE_INTERVAL
entries.description: How often (minutes) execution data should be hard-deleted.

entries.name: EXECUTIONS_DATA_PRUNE_MAX_COUNT
entries.description: Maximum number of executions to keep in the database. 0 = no limit

entries.name: EXECUTIONS_DATA_PRUNE_SOFT_DELETE_INTERVAL
entries.description: How often (minutes) execution data should be soft-deleted.

entries.name: EXECUTIONS_DATA_SAVE_MANUAL_EXECUTIONS
entries.description: Whether to save data of executions when started manually.

entries.name: EXECUTIONS_DATA_SAVE_ON_ERROR
entries.description: Whether n8n saves execution data on error.

entries.name: EXECUTIONS_DATA_SAVE_ON_PROGRESS
entries.description: Whether to save progress for each node executed (true) or not (false).

entries.name: EXECUTIONS_DATA_SAVE_ON_SUCCESS
entries.description: Whether n8n saves execution data on success.

entries.name: EXECUTIONS_MODE
entries.description:
Whether executions should run directly or using queue.

Refer to Queue mode for more details.

entries.name: EXECUTIONS_TIMEOUT
entries.description: Sets a default timeout (in seconds) to all workflows after which n8n stops their execution. Users can override this for individual workflows up to the duration set in EXECUTIONS_TIMEOUT_MAX. Set EXECUTIONS_TIMEOUT to -1 to disable.

entries.name: EXECUTIONS_TIMEOUT_MAX
entries.description: The maximum execution time (in seconds) that users can set for an individual workflow.

entries.name: EXTERNAL_FRONTEND_HOOKS_URLS
entries.description: URLs to files containing frontend external hooks. Provide multiple URLs as a colon-separated list (":").

entries.name: EXTERNAL_HOOK_FILES
entries.description: Files containing backend external hooks. Provide multiple files separated by the character defined in EXTERNAL_HOOK_FILES_SEPARATOR.

entries.name: EXTERNAL_HOOK_FILES_SEPARATOR
entries.description: Separator character for EXTERNAL_HOOK_FILES. Use ; on Windows to avoid conflicts with drive-letter paths like C:\.

entries.name: GENERIC_TIMEZONE
entries.description: The same default timezone as configured for the n8n instance.

entries.name: GENERIC_TIMEZONE
entries.description: The n8n instance timezone. Important for schedule nodes (such as Cron).

entries.name: HTTPS_PROXY
entries.description: A URL to proxy TLS/SSL encrypted HTTP requests through. When set, n8n proxies all TLS/SSL encrypted HTTP traffic from nodes through the proxy URL.

entries.name: HTTP_PROXY
entries.description: A URL to proxy unencrypted HTTP requests through. When set, n8n proxies all unencrypted HTTP traffic from nodes through the proxy URL.

entries.name: N8N_AGENTS_TRACING_ENABLED
entries.description: Whether agent runs emit OpenTelemetry spans. Inherits the endpoint, headers, sampling, and transport settings from N8N_OTEL_*. Spans have nowhere to go until you configure an OTel provider, so set this to false to run workflow tracing without agent spans.

entries.name: N8N_AGENTS_TRACING_RECORD_INPUTS
entries.description: Whether agent tracing records inputs, such as prompts and tool arguments. Set to false to exclude sensitive input data from traces.

entries.name: N8N_AGENTS_TRACING_RECORD_OUTPUTS
entries.description: Whether agent tracing records outputs, such as responses and tool results. Set to false to exclude sensitive output data from traces.

entries.name: N8N_AI_ASSISTANT_BASE_URL
entries.description: Base URL of the AI assistant service, specified as https://ai-assistant.n8n.io . Required if you self-host n8n and want to enable Ask n8n AI.

entries.name: N8N_AI_TIMEOUT_MAX
entries.description: Sets the HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for AI and LLM nodes (such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, and Ollama). This controls how long n8n waits for responses from AI services before timing out. Useful for slower local AI services or complex prompts that require longer processing time.

entries.name: N8N_AVAILABLE_BINARY_DATA_MODES
entries.description: A comma separated list of available binary data modes.

entries.name: N8N_BINARY_DATA_DATABASE_MAX_FILE_SIZE
entries.description: Maximum size (in MiB) of a single file n8n stores when N8N_DEFAULT_BINARY_DATA_MODE is database. Can't exceed 1024, the limit of a database column. Storing a larger file fails.

entries.name: N8N_BINARY_DATA_STORAGE_PATH
entries.description: The path where n8n stores binary data.

entries.name: N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE
entries.description: Whether to allow users to access environment variables in expressions and the Code node (false) or not (true).

entries.name: N8N_BLOCK_FILE_ACCESS_TO_N8N_FILES
entries.description: Set to true to block access to all files in the .n8n directory and user defined configuration files.

entries.name: N8N_BLOCK_RUNNER_ENV_ACCESS
entries.description: Whether to block access to the runner's environment from within Python code tasks. Set to false to enable all Python code node users access to the runner's environment via os.environ. For security reasons, environment variable access is blocked by default.

entries.name: N8N_CACHE_REDIS_KEY_PREFIX
entries.description: Prefix for cache keys in Redis. n8n adds it after N8N_REDIS_KEY_PREFIX, for example n8n:cache.

entries.name: N8N_CANVAS_ONLY
entries.description: Set to true to run n8n in canvas-only mode, hiding the header, sidebar, and overlay elements when viewing an individual workflow. Available from n8n 2.15.0.

entries.name: N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_AUTH_TOKEN
entries.description: Authentication token for a private npm registry. Use with N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_REGISTRY to authenticate requests when installing community nodes from a private registry.

entries.name: N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_ENABLED
entries.description: Enables (true) or disables (false) the functionality to install and load community nodes. If set to false, neither verified nor unverified community packages will be available, regardless of their individual settings.

entries.name: N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_PREVENT_LOADING
entries.description: Prevents (true) or allows (false) loading installed community nodes on instance startup. Use this if a faulty node prevents the instance from starting.

entries.name: N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_REGISTRY
entries.description: NPM registry URL to pull community packages from (license required).

entries.name: N8N_COMPRESSION_NODE_MAX_DECOMPRESSED_SIZE_BYTES
entries.description: Maximum total decompressed output size in bytes. Default is 256 MiB.

entries.name: N8N_COMPRESSION_NODE_MAX_ZIP_ENTRIES
entries.description: Maximum number of entries allowed in a ZIP archive.

entries.name: N8N_CONCURRENCY_EVALUATION_LIMIT
entries.description: Max test cases that can run in parallel within a single evaluation test run. When unset, the limit follows the license tier: self-hosted Community: 1, n8n Cloud Pro: 1, self-hosted Business: 3, n8n Cloud Enterprise and self-hosted Enterprise: 5. Setting this overrides the tier default.

entries.name: N8N_CONCURRENCY_PRODUCTION_LIMIT
entries.description: Max production executions allowed to run concurrently, in both regular and scaling modes. -1 to disable in regular mode.

entries.name: N8N_CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY
entries.description: The Content-Security-Policy n8n serves on its own pages. Accepts a policy string, for example frame-ancestors http://localhost:3000, or a helmet.js directives object. Write <nonce> where n8n inserts the per-request nonce. Set to default for n8n's policy, or {} for no header.

entries.name: N8N_CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY_REPORT_ONLY
entries.description: The policy n8n serves as Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only, in the same formats as N8N_CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY. The browser reports violations but doesn't block them, so use it to try a policy before enforcing it.

entries.name: N8N_CUSTOM_EXTENSIONS
entries.description: Specify the path to directories containing your custom nodes.

entries.name: N8N_DEFAULT_BINARY_DATA_MODE
entries.description: The default binary data mode. default keeps binary data in memory. Set to filesystem to use the filesystem, s3 to use AWS S3, azure to use Azure Blob Storage, or database to use the DB. Note that binary data pruning operates on the active binary data mode. For example, if your instance stored data i

entries.name: N8N_DEFAULT_LOCALE
entries.description: A locale identifier, compatible with the Accept-Language header. n8n doesn't support regional identifiers, such as de-AT. When running in a locale other than the default, n8n displays UI strings in the selected locale, and falls back to en for any untranslated strings.

entries.name: N8N_DEV_RELOAD
entries.description: When working on the n8n source code, set this to true to automatically reload or restart the application when changes occur in the source code files.

entries.name: N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_CONFIG_BACKEND
entries.description: Telemetry configuration for the backend.

entries.name: N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_CONFIG_FRONTEND
entries.description: Telemetry configuration for the frontend.

entries.name: N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED
entries.description: Whether to share selected, anonymous telemetry with n8n. Note that if you set this to false, you can't enable Ask AI in the Code node.

entries.name: N8N_DISABLED_MODULES
entries.description: Set to insights to disable the feature and metrics collection for an instance.

entries.name: N8N_DISABLE_PRODUCTION_MAIN_PROCESS
entries.description: Disable production webhooks from main process. This helps ensure no HTTP traffic load to main process when using webhook-specific processes.

entries.name: N8N_DISABLE_UI
entries.description: Set to true to disable the UI.

entries.name: N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL
entries.description: Public URL where users can access the editor. Also used for emails sent from n8n and the redirect URL for SAML based authentication.

entries.name: N8N_EMAIL_MODE
entries.description: Enable emails.

entries.name: N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY
entries.description: Provide a custom key used to encrypt credentials in the n8n database. By default n8n generates a random key on first launch.

entries.name: N8N_ENDPOINT_FORM
entries.description: The path used for the form endpoint.

entries.name: N8N_ENDPOINT_FORM_TEST
entries.description: The path used for the test-form endpoint.

entries.name: N8N_ENDPOINT_FORM_WAIT
entries.description: The path used for the waiting-form endpoint.

entries.name: N8N_ENDPOINT_HEALTH
entries.description: The path used for health check endpoint.

entries.name: N8N_ENDPOINT_REST
entries.description: The path used for REST endpoint.

entries.name: N8N_ENDPOINT_WEBHOOK
entries.description: The path used for webhook endpoint.

entries.name: N8N_ENDPOINT_WEBHOOK_TEST
entries.description: The path used for test-webhook endpoint.

entries.name: N8N_ENDPOINT_WEBHOOK_WAIT
entries.description: The path used for waiting-webhook endpoint.

entries.name: N8N_ENFORCE_GLOBAL_USER_AGENT
entries.description: When set to true, n8n replaces the default bare n8n User-Agent string with an RFC-compliant value (Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; n8n/<version>; +https://n8n.io/)) on all outbound HTTP requests. Enable this to prevent web application firewalls from blocking n8n requests.

entries.name: N8N_ENFORCE_SETTINGS_FILE_PERMISSIONS
entries.description: Set to true to try to set 0600 permissions for the settings file, giving only the owner read and write access.

entries.name: N8N_ENV_FEAT_ENCRYPTION_KEY_ROTATION
entries.description: Set to true on all instances (main and workers) to enable encryption key rotation. One-way change: take a full database backup first.

entries.name: N8N_ENV_FEAT_OAUTH2_JWE
entries.description: Set to true on all instances (main and workers) to enable JWE token decryption for OAuth 2.0 credentials. Preview feature.

entries.name: N8N_ENV_FEAT_TOKEN_EXCHANGE
entries.description: Set to true to enable token exchange for embedding partners. Preview feature.

entries.name: N8N_EVENTBUS_CHECKUNSENTINTERVAL
entries.description: How often (in milliseconds) to check for unsent event messages. Can in rare cases send message twice. Set to 0 to disable it.

entries.name: N8N_EVENTBUS_LOGWRITER_KEEPLOGCOUNT
entries.description: Number of event log files to keep.

entries.name: N8N_EVENTBUS_LOGWRITER_LOGBASENAME
entries.description: Basename of the event log file. Ignored when N8N_EVENTBUS_LOGWRITER_LOGFULLPATH is set.

entries.name: N8N_EVENTBUS_LOGWRITER_LOGFULLPATH
entries.description: Absolute path to the event log file. Must end in .log. When set, this path is used verbatim and overrides N8N_EVENTBUS_LOGWRITER_LOGBASENAME and the default per-process suffix. Use this to give each n8n process a unique event log path when multiple processes share a writable filesystem. Refer to Per

entries.name: N8N_EVENTBUS_LOGWRITER_MAXFILESIZEINKB
entries.description: Maximum size (in kilo-bytes) of an event log file before a new one starts.

entries.name: N8N_EVENTBUS_LOGWRITER_MAXTOTALMESSAGESPERFILE
entries.description: Maximum number of lines parsed from a single event log file during recovery. Bounds memory use when an event log file contains many invalid lines.

entries.name: N8N_EVENTBUS_LOGWRITER_SYNCFILEACCESS
entries.description: Whether all file access happens synchronously within the thread (true) or not (false).

entries.name: N8N_EXECUTION_DATA_STORAGE_MODE
entries.type: Enum string: database, filesystem, s3, azure
entries.description: Where n8n stores execution data. The s3 and azure modes require a self-hosted Business or Enterprise plan. Refer to External data storage for the related storage variables.

entries.name: N8N_EXPRESSION_ENGINE
entries.description: Which expression engine the backend uses. vm runs expressions in a sandboxed V8 isolate. quickjs runs them in a QuickJS sandbox compiled to WebAssembly. legacy runs them without isolation, and n8n plans to deprecate it. vm is the default from n8n 2.35.0. Earlier n8n versions default to legacy.

entries.name: N8N_EXPRESSION_ENGINE_FRONTEND
entries.description: Which expression engine the editor uses in the browser. quickjs runs expressions in a QuickJS sandbox compiled to WebAssembly, isolated from the rest of the page. legacy runs them without isolation. n8n strongly recommends quickjs. Available from n8n 2.41.0.

entries.name: N8N_EXPRESSION_ENGINE_IDLE_TIMEOUT
entries.description: If set, scales the pool to zero warm sandboxes after this many seconds with no activity.

entries.name: N8N_EXPRESSION_ENGINE_MAX_CODE_CACHE_SIZE
entries.description: Maximum number of compiled expressions to cache.

entries.name: N8N_EXPRESSION_ENGINE_MEMORY_LIMIT
entries.description: Memory limit in MiB for each sandbox.

entries.name: N8N_EXPRESSION_ENGINE_POOL_SIZE
entries.description: Number of sandboxes kept warm in the pool.

entries.name: N8N_EXPRESSION_ENGINE_TIMEOUT
entries.description: Execution timeout in milliseconds for each expression evaluation.

entries.name: N8N_EXTERNAL_SECRETS_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
entries.description: Maximum time (in seconds) n8n waits for a secrets vault to connect. If the vault doesn't answer in time, n8n marks it as errored, retries the connection in the background with increasing delays, and startup continues without its secrets. Available from n8n 2.41.0.

entries.name: N8N_EXTERNAL_SECRETS_REFRESH_TIMEOUT
entries.description: Maximum time (in seconds) n8n waits for a secrets vault to deliver its secrets, at startup and on each update interval. If the fetch takes longer, n8n stops waiting and the fetch keeps running in the background. When it completes successfully, n8n stores the secrets. At startup, workflows that use s

entries.name: N8N_EXTERNAL_SECRETS_UPDATE_INTERVAL
entries.description: How often (in seconds) to check for secret updates.

entries.name: N8N_EXTERNAL_STORAGE_AZURE_ACCOUNT_KEY
entries.description: Storage account key. Use with the account name.

entries.name: N8N_EXTERNAL_STORAGE_AZURE_ACCOUNT_NAME
entries.description: Storage account name. Use with an account key or managed identity.

entries.name: N8N_EXTERNAL_STORAGE_AZURE_AUTH_AUTO_DETECT
entries.description: Authenticate via DefaultAzureCredential (managed identity, environment, or Azure CLI) instead of an account key. Ignores the account key when enabled.

entries.name: N8N_EXTERNAL_STORAGE_AZURE_CONNECTION_STRING
entries.description: Connection string for Azure Blob Storage. Takes precedence over the account name and key when set.

entries.name: N8N_EXTERNAL_STORAGE_AZURE_CONTAINER_NAME
entries.description: Name of the blob container to store execution data and/or binary data in. Required for Azure Blob Storage.

entries.name: N8N_EXTERNAL_STORAGE_AZURE_ENDPOINT
entries.description: Custom blob endpoint, for example for Azurite or sovereign clouds.

entries.name: N8N_EXTERNAL_STORAGE_S3_ACCESS_KEY
entries.description: Access key in S3-compatible external storage

entries.name: N8N_EXTERNAL_STORAGE_S3_ACCESS_SECRET
entries.description: Access secret in S3-compatible external storage.

entries.name: N8N_EXTERNAL_STORAGE_S3_AUTH_AUTO_DETECT
entries.description: Use automatic credential detection to authenticate S3 calls for external storage. This will ignore the access key and access secret and use the default credential provider chain.

entries.name: N8N_EXTERNAL_STORAGE_S3_BUCKET_NAME
entries.description: Name of the n8n bucket in S3-compatible external storage.

entries.name: N8N_EXTERNAL_STORAGE_S3_BUCKET_REGION
entries.description: Region of the n8n bucket in S3-compatible external storage. For example, us-east-1

entries.name: N8N_EXTERNAL_STORAGE_S3_HOST
entries.description: Host of the n8n bucket in S3-compatible external storage. For example, s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com

entries.name: N8N_FORMDATA_FILE_SIZE_MAX
entries.description: Max payload size for files in form-data webhook payloads in MiB.

entries.name: N8N_GIT_NODE_DISABLE_BARE_REPOS
entries.description: Set to true to prevent the Git node from working with bare repositories, enhancing security.

entries.name: N8N_GIT_NODE_ENABLE_HOOKS
entries.description: Set to true to allow the Git node to execute Git hooks.

entries.name: N8N_GLOBAL_USER_AGENT_VALUE
entries.description: A custom User-Agent string to use for all outbound HTTP requests. Overrides the RFC-compliant default set by N8N_ENFORCE_GLOBAL_USER_AGENT. Useful when you don't want to disclose the n8n version to upstream servers.

entries.name: N8N_GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT
entries.description: How long should the n8n process wait (in seconds) for components to shut down before exiting the process.

entries.name: N8N_HIDE_USAGE_PAGE
entries.description: Hide the Plan & usage page in the app.

entries.name: N8N_HIRING_BANNER_ENABLED
entries.description: Whether to show the n8n hiring banner in the console (true) or not (false).

entries.name: N8N_HOST
entries.description: Host name n8n runs on.

entries.name: N8N_INSECURE_DISABLE_FORM_HTML_SANDBOX
entries.description: Whether to remove the sandbox directive from the Content Security Policy (CSP) on form pages. Only for forms on a separate hostname from the editor. Available from n8n 2.15.0. Refer to Configure webhook URLs with reverse proxy for full details and safety conditions.

entries.name: N8N_INSIGHTS_COMPACTION_BATCH_DELAY_MILLISECONDS
entries.description: Delay in milliseconds between full compaction batches. Increase this to wait longer between batches. Set to 0 to skip the delay.

entries.name: N8N_INSIGHTS_COMPACTION_BATCH_SIZE
entries.description: The number of raw insights data to compact in a single batch.

entries.name: N8N_INSIGHTS_COMPACTION_DAILY_TO_WEEKLY_THRESHOLD_DAYS
entries.description: Age in days after which n8n compacts daily insights rows to weekly.

entries.name: N8N_INSIGHTS_COMPACTION_HOURLY_TO_DAILY_THRESHOLD_DAYS
entries.description: Age in days after which n8n compacts hourly insights rows to daily.

entries.name: N8N_INSIGHTS_COMPACTION_INTERVAL_MINUTES
entries.description: Interval (in minutes) at which compaction should run. Decrease this to run compaction more often and reduce how much data builds up between runs.

entries.name: N8N_INSIGHTS_COMPACTION_MAX_BATCHES_PER_RUN
entries.description: Maximum number of compaction batches to process in one run. Decrease this to process fewer batches per run. Set to 0 to disable this limit.

entries.name: N8N_INSIGHTS_COMPACTION_MAX_RUNTIME_SECONDS
entries.description: Maximum runtime in seconds for one compaction run. Decrease this to stop each run sooner. Set to 0 to disable this limit.

entries.name: N8N_INSIGHTS_FLUSH_BATCH_SIZE
entries.description: The maximum number of insights data to keep in the buffer before flushing.

entries.name: N8N_INSIGHTS_FLUSH_INTERVAL_SECONDS
entries.description: The interval (in seconds) at which n8n flushes insights data to the database.

entries.name: N8N_INSIGHTS_MAX_AGE_DAYS
entries.description: Number of days n8n keeps compacted insights data before pruning. The maximum value is 730 (two years).

entries.name: N8N_INSIGHTS_PRUNE_CHECK_INTERVAL_HOURS
entries.description: How often (in hours) the instance checks for insights data older than the effective max age and deletes it.

entries.name: N8N_INVITE_LINKS_EMAIL_ONLY
entries.description: When set to true, n8n will only deliver invite links via email and will not expose them through the API. This option enhances security by preventing invite URLs from being accessible programmatically, or to high privileged users.

entries.name: N8N_LICENSE_ACTIVATION_KEY
entries.description: Activation key to initialize license. Not applicable if the n8n instance was already activated.

entries.name: N8N_LICENSE_AUTO_RENEW_ENABLED
entries.description:
Enables (true) or disables (false) autorenewal for licenses.
If disabled, you need to manually renew the license every 10 days by navigating to Settings > Plan & usage, and pressing F5. Failure to renew the license will disable all licensed featur

entries.name: N8N_LICENSE_CERT
entries.description: Base64-encoded license certificate provided by n8n. Used instead of N8N_LICENSE_ACTIVATION_KEY for special use cases, e.g. air-gapped environments.

entries.name: N8N_LICENSE_DETACH_FLOATING_ON_SHUTDOWN
entries.description: Controls whether the instance releases floating entitlements back to the pool upon shutdown. Set to true to allow other instances to reuse the entitlements, or false to reta

entries.name: N8N_LICENSE_SERVER_URL
entries.description: Server URL to retrieve license.

entries.name: N8N_LICENSE_TENANT_ID
entries.description: Tenant ID associated with the license. Only set this variable if explicitly instructed by n8n.

entries.name: N8N_LISTEN_ADDRESS
entries.description: The IP address n8n should listen on.

entries.name: N8N_LOG_CRON_ACTIVE_INTERVAL
entries.description: Interval in minutes to log currently active cron jobs. Set to 0 to disable.

entries.name: N8N_LOG_FILE_COUNT_MAX
entries.description: Max number of log files to keep.

entries.name: N8N_LOG_FILE_LOCATION
entries.description: Log file location. Requires N8N_LOG_OUTPUT set to file.

entries.name: N8N_LOG_FILE_SIZE_MAX
entries.description: Max size of each log file in MB.

entries.name: N8N_LOG_FORMAT
entries.description: The log format to use. text prints human readable messages. json prints one JSON object per line containing the message, level, timestamp, and all metadata. This is useful for production monitoring as well as debugging.

entries.name: N8N_LOG_LEVEL
entries.type: Enum string: info, warn, error, debug
entries.description: Log output level. Refer to Log levels for details.

entries.name: N8N_LOG_OUTPUT
entries.description: Where to output logs. Provide multiple values as a comma-separated list.

entries.name: N8N_MANAGED_OAUTH_SHOW_SCOPES
entries.description: Comma-separated list of managed OAuth credential types for which users can configure scope fields.

entries.name: N8N_MCP_BASE_URL
entries.description: Public base URL where MCP clients reach the instance-level MCP server, when it differs from the instance base URL. Useful for deployments that serve the MCP server on a dedicated hostname (for example, https://n8n-mcp.example.com in front of the same instance). When set, n8n advertises the MCP serve

entries.name: N8N_MCP_SERVER_RATE_LIMIT
entries.description: Maximum number of requests per IP, per 5 minutes, to the MCP server endpoint (/mcp-server/http).

entries.name: N8N_METRICS
entries.description: Whether to enable the /metrics endpoint.

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_INCLUDE_API_ENDPOINTS
entries.description: Whether to expose metrics for API endpoints.

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_INCLUDE_API_METHOD_LABEL
entries.description: Whether to include a label for the HTTP method (GET, POST, ...) of API invocations.

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_INCLUDE_API_PATH_LABEL
entries.description: Whether to include a label for the path of API invocations.

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_INCLUDE_API_STATUS_CODE_LABEL
entries.description: Whether to include a label for the HTTP status code (200, 404, ...) of API invocations.

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_INCLUDE_CACHE_METRICS
entries.description: Whether to include metrics (true) for cache hits and misses, or not include them (false).

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_INCLUDE_CREDENTIAL_TYPE_LABEL
entries.description: Whether to include a label for the credential type on credential metrics.

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_INCLUDE_DEFAULT_METRICS
entries.description: Whether to expose default system and node.js metrics.

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_INCLUDE_DNS_CACHE_METRICS
entries.description: Whether to include metrics for the DNS cache (currently only used by SSRF protection).

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_INCLUDE_MESSAGE_EVENT_BUS_METRICS
entries.description: Whether to include metrics (true) for events, or not include them (false).

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_INCLUDE_NODE_TYPE_LABEL
entries.description: Whether to include a label for the node type on node metrics.

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_INCLUDE_POLL_TRIGGER_METRICS
entries.description: Whether to include metrics for trigger nodes that poll, such as poll duration, poll errors, overlapping polls, and cursor commits. Main instances only. For what each metric means, see Poll trigger metrics.

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_INCLUDE_QUEUE_METRICS
entries.description: Whether to include metrics for jobs in scaling mode.

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_INCLUDE_SCHEDULER_METRICS
entries.description: Whether to include metrics for the durable scheduler, such as queue depth, scheduling lag, dispatch throughput, retries, and dead-letters. Main instances only. For what each metric means, see Durable scheduler observability.

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_INCLUDE_SSRF_METRICS
entries.description: Whether to include metrics for SSRF protection checks.

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_INCLUDE_SYSTEM_TASK_METRICS
entries.description: Whether to include metrics for n8n's internal maintenance tasks, such as run duration, last success, skipped occurrences, and timer lag. Main instances only. For what each metric means, see System task observability.

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_INCLUDE_WORKFLOW_ID_LABEL
entries.description: Whether to include a label for the workflow ID on workflow metrics.

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_PREFIX
entries.description: Optional prefix for n8n specific metrics names.

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_QUEUE_METRICS_INTERVAL
entries.description: How often (in seconds) to update queue metrics.

entries.name: N8N_METRICS_SCHEDULER_INTERVAL
entries.description: How often (in seconds) to refresh the queue-health gauges for the durable scheduler. See Durable scheduler observability.

entries.name: N8N_MFA_ENABLED
entries.description: Whether to enable two-factor authentication (true) or disable (false). n8n ignores this if existing users have 2FA enabled.

entries.name: N8N_MULTI_MAIN_SETUP_CHECK_INTERVAL
entries.description: Interval (in seconds) for leader check in multi-main setup.

entries.name: N8N_MULTI_MAIN_SETUP_ENABLED
entries.description: Whether to enable multi-main setup for queue mode (license required).

entries.name: N8N_MULTI_MAIN_SETUP_KEY_TTL
entries.description: Time to live (in seconds) for leader key in multi-main setup.

entries.name: N8N_OAUTH_JWE_JWKS_PER_MINUTE
entries.description: Per-IP rate limit on the public JWKS endpoint (/rest/.well-known/jwks.json) used by JWE token decryption for OAuth 2.0 credentials.

entries.name: N8N_OAUTH_SERVER_AUTHORIZE_RATE_LIMIT
entries.description: Maximum number of requests per IP, per 5 minutes, to the OAuth server authorization endpoint (/oauth/authorize and /mcp-oauth/authorize).

entries.name: N8N_OAUTH_SERVER_REGISTER_RATE_LIMIT
entries.description: Maximum number of requests per IP, per 5 minutes, to the OAuth server client registration endpoint (/oauth/register and /mcp-oauth/register).

entries.name: N8N_OAUTH_SERVER_REVOKE_RATE_LIMIT
entries.description: Maximum number of requests per IP, per 5 minutes, to the OAuth server token revocation endpoint (/oauth/revoke and /mcp-oauth/revoke).

entries.name: N8N_OAUTH_SERVER_TOKEN_RATE_LIMIT
entries.description: Maximum number of requests per IP, per 5 minutes, to the OAuth server token endpoint (/oauth/token and /mcp-oauth/token).

entries.name: N8N_ONBOARDING_FLOW_DISABLED
entries.description: Whether to disable onboarding tips when creating a new workflow (true) or not (false).

entries.name: N8N_OTEL_ENABLED
entries.description: Whether to enable OpenTelemetry tracing. When set to false, n8n doesn't load the OpenTelemetry SDK.

entries.name: N8N_OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
entries.description: Base URL of the OTLP endpoint to export traces to. The value must be an http:// or https:// URL. If it isn't, n8n logs a warning and uses the default. For http/protobuf, n8n appends the value of N8N_OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACING_PATH to this URL.

entries.name: N8N_OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS
entries.description: Comma-separated list of key=value pairs to send as HTTP headers with each OTLP request. Use this for authentication tokens or tenant headers. For example: authorization=Bearer <token>,x-tenant=acme. With the grpc protocol, n8n sends these as gRPC metadata and converts the keys to lowercase.

entries.name: N8N_OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL
entries.description: OTLP transport for exporting traces. Valid values: http/protobuf and grpc. The name and values match the upstream OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL specification. Refer to Choose the OTLP protocol for guidance.

entries.name: N8N_OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACING_PATH
entries.description: Path appended to N8N_OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT for exporting traces. n8n ignores this variable when N8N_OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL is grpc, because gRPC endpoints take no URL path.

entries.name: N8N_OTEL_EXPORTER_SERVICE_NAME
entries.description: Value of the service.name resource attribute on exported spans.

entries.name: N8N_OTEL_STARTUP_CONNECTIVITY_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Timeout (in milliseconds) for the startup connectivity check against the OTLP endpoint. n8n logs an error if the endpoint isn't reachable within this period.

entries.name: N8N_OTEL_TRACES_CUSTOM_ATTRIBUTE_PREFIXES
entries.description: JSON object that changes or removes the prefix on custom span attribute keys, for example {"project":"","node":""}. Refer to Change the attribute prefixes.

entries.name: N8N_OTEL_TRACES_EMIT_NODE_START_SPAN
entries.description: Whether to send a 0 ms node.execute.started span when a node execution starts. Needs N8N_OTEL_TRACES_INCLUDE_NODE_SPANS set to true. Refer to Start spans.

entries.name: N8N_OTEL_TRACES_EMIT_WORKFLOW_START_SPAN
entries.description: Whether to send a 0 ms workflow.execute.started span when a workflow execution starts. Refer to Start spans.

entries.name: N8N_OTEL_TRACES_INCLUDE_NODE_SPANS
entries.description: Whether to emit a node.execute span for each node execution. Set to false to export workflow-level spans only.

entries.name: N8N_OTEL_TRACES_INJECT_OUTBOUND
entries.description: Whether n8n adds tracing headers to outbound HTTP requests made by nodes that use n8n's HTTP helpers. When true, n8n sends traceparent, tracestate, and baggage (from n8n 2.47.0). Use OTEL_PROPAGATORS to narrow the set. Refer to Outbound trace headers.

entries.name: N8N_OTEL_TRACES_PRODUCTION_ONLY
entries.description: Whether to export traces for production executions only. Set to false to export traces for all workflow executions.

entries.name: N8N_OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE
entries.description: Fraction of traces to export, between 0 and 1. n8n uses a trace ID ratio sampler, so all spans in a trace are either sampled or dropped together.

entries.name: N8N_PATH
entries.description: The path n8n deploys to. Combining N8N_PATH with reverse proxies can cause folder navigation issues. Use a subdomain (for example, n8n.example.com) or use N8N_PATH without reverse proxy.

entries.name: N8N_PAYLOAD_SIZE_MAX
entries.description: The maximum payload size in MiB. The default is 16 MiB, but this can be increased by adjusting the variable to a higher value. The n8n instance needs to be restarted to apply the new setting. Note: Increasing the payload size requires more memory and CPU resources and may impact performance. Ensure

entries.name: N8N_PERSONALIZATION_ENABLED
entries.description: Whether to ask users personalisation questions and then customise n8n accordingly.

entries.name: N8N_POLLER_DURABLE_CURSORS_ENABLED
entries.description: Whether n8n stores a poll trigger node's cursor in a dedicated database table and commits it in the same transaction as the execution the poll produced, so a crash mid-poll can't drop or duplicate data. Available from n8n 2.36.0. From n8n 2.37.0, requires N8N_SCHEDULER_ENABLED, N8N_SCHEDULER_POLL_TR

entries.name: N8N_PORT
entries.description: The HTTP port n8n runs on.

entries.name: N8N_POSTMESSAGE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
entries.description: Origins allowed to exchange postMessage commands with the editor when it's embedded in another page. Only relevant when embedding the editor is possible, for example when running with N8N_PREVIEW_MODE=true. Provide multiple origins as a comma-separated list, for example https://n8n.io,https://app.ex

entries.name: N8N_PREVIEW_MODE
entries.description: Set to true to run in preview mode.

entries.name: N8N_PROTOCOL
entries.description: The protocol used to reach n8n.

entries.name: N8N_PROXY_HOPS
entries.description: Number of reverse-proxies n8n is running behind.

entries.name: N8N_PUBLIC_API_DISABLED
entries.description: Whether to disable the public API (true) or not (false).

entries.name: N8N_PUBLIC_API_ENDPOINT
entries.description: Path for the public API endpoints.

entries.name: N8N_PUBLIC_API_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED
entries.description: Whether n8n limits how many public API requests each API key can make. A request over a limit gets a 429 response. n8n counts only requests that use an API key. Each N8N_PUBLIC_API_RATE_LIMIT_* variable you set overrides its own field in Settings > Policies, and you can't change that field there. Re

entries.name: N8N_PUBLIC_API_RATE_LIMIT_ENDPOINT_READ_LIMIT
entries.description: Maximum number of read requests (GET) that one API key can make to each public API endpoint in each window. An endpoint is a method and a path, so GET /workflows/{id} is one endpoint for every workflow ID. Set to 0 for no limit.

entries.name: N8N_PUBLIC_API_RATE_LIMIT_ENDPOINT_READ_WINDOW_SECONDS
entries.description: Length of the window for N8N_PUBLIC_API_RATE_LIMIT_ENDPOINT_READ_LIMIT, in seconds. The count starts again when the window ends.

entries.name: N8N_PUBLIC_API_RATE_LIMIT_ENDPOINT_WRITE_LIMIT
entries.description: Maximum number of write requests (POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE) that one API key can make to each public API endpoint in each window. An endpoint is a method and a path, so DELETE /workflows/{id} is one endpoint for every workflow ID. Set to 0 for no limit.

entries.name: N8N_PUBLIC_API_RATE_LIMIT_ENDPOINT_WRITE_WINDOW_SECONDS
entries.description: Length of the window for N8N_PUBLIC_API_RATE_LIMIT_ENDPOINT_WRITE_LIMIT, in seconds. The count starts again when the window ends.

entries.name: N8N_PUBLIC_API_RATE_LIMIT_GLOBAL_READ_LIMIT
entries.description: Maximum number of read requests (GET) that one API key can make to all public API endpoints together in each window. Set to 0 for no limit.

entries.name: N8N_PUBLIC_API_RATE_LIMIT_GLOBAL_READ_WINDOW_SECONDS
entries.description: Length of the window for N8N_PUBLIC_API_RATE_LIMIT_GLOBAL_READ_LIMIT, in seconds. The count starts again when the window ends.

entries.name: N8N_PUBLIC_API_RATE_LIMIT_GLOBAL_WRITE_LIMIT
entries.description: Maximum number of write requests (POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE) that one API key can make to all public API endpoints together in each window. Set to 0 for no limit.

entries.name: N8N_PUBLIC_API_RATE_LIMIT_GLOBAL_WRITE_WINDOW_SECONDS
entries.description: Length of the window for N8N_PUBLIC_API_RATE_LIMIT_GLOBAL_WRITE_LIMIT, in seconds. The count starts again when the window ends.

entries.name: N8N_PUBLIC_API_SWAGGERUI_DISABLED
entries.description: Whether the Swagger UI (API playground) is disabled (true) or not (false).

entries.name: N8N_PUSH_BACKEND
entries.description: Choose whether the n8n backend uses server-sent events (sse) or WebSockets (websocket) to send changes to the UI.

entries.name: N8N_PYTHON_ENABLED
entries.description: Whether to enable Python execution on the Code node.

entries.name: N8N_REDIS_KEY_PREFIX
entries.description: Prefix for Redis keys and pub/sub channels outside the job queue, such as the multi-main leader key, messages between main and worker instances, the cache, and locks. If two or more n8n deployments share one Redis, give each deployment a different value. Use the same value on every main and worker o

entries.name: N8N_REINSTALL_MISSING_PACKAGES
entries.description: If set to true, n8n will automatically attempt to reinstall any missing packages.

entries.name: N8N_RESTRICT_FILE_ACCESS_TO
entries.description: Limits access to files in these directories. Provide multiple files as a semicolon-separated list (";").

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_ALLOW_PROTOTYPE_MUTATION
entries.description: Whether to allow prototype mutation for external libraries. Set to true to allow modules that rely on runtime prototype mutation (for example, puppeteer) at the cost of relaxing security.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_ALLOW_TRANSITIVE_IMPORTS
entries.description: Whether imports performed by an allowlisted package's own code skip the import allowlist (both N8N_RUNNERS_EXTERNAL_ALLOW and N8N_RUNNERS_STDLIB_ALLOW). Set to true to let an allowlisted package load whatever it imports (its transitive dependencies and stdlib) without listing each module. This helps

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN
entries.description: Shared secret used by a task runner to authenticate to n8n. Required when using external mode.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN
entries.description: Shared secret used to authenticate to n8n.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_AUTO_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT
entries.description: The number of seconds to wait before shutting down an idle runner.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_AUTO_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT
entries.description: The number of seconds to wait before shutting down an idle runner.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_BROKER_LISTEN_ADDRESS
entries.description: Address the task broker listens on.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_BROKER_PORT
entries.description: Port the task broker listens on for task runner connections.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_BUILTINS_DENY
entries.description: Python built-ins that you can't use in the Code node. Set to an empty string to allow all built-ins.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_EXTERNAL_ALLOW
entries.description: Third-party Python modules that are allowed to be used in the Code node, including their submodules. Use * to allow all external modules. n8n disables all third-party Python modules by default. Third-party Python modules must be included in the n8nio/runners image. In external mode, set this in the

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_GRANT_TOKEN
entries.description: Token the runner uses to authenticate with the task broker. This is automatically provided by the launcher.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL
entries.description: The interval, in seconds, at which the runner must send a heartbeat to the broker. If the runner doesn't send a heartbeat in time, the task stops and the runner restarts. This value must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_ID
entries.description: ID the runner identifies itself with to the task broker. In internal mode, n8n sets it for each runner it launches. In external mode, leave it unset unless you need stable IDs in the broker logs: every runner needs a unique value, and two runners sharing one keep evicting each other. Set it per runn

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_INSECURE_MODE
entries.description: Whether to disable all security measures in the task runner, for compatibility with modules that rely on insecure JS features. Discouraged for production use.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_LAUNCHER_HEALTH_CHECK_PORT
entries.description: Port for the launcher's health check server.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_LAUNCHER_HEALTH_CHECK_PORT
entries.description: Port for the launcher's health check server.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_LAUNCHER_LOG_LEVEL
entries.type: Enum string: debug, info, warn, error
entries.description: Which log messages to show.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_MAX_CONCURRENCY
entries.description: The number of concurrent tasks a task runner can execute at a time.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_MAX_CONCURRENCY
entries.description: The number of concurrent tasks a task runner can execute at a time.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_MAX_CONCURRENCY
entries.description: The number of concurrent tasks a task runner can execute at a time.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_MAX_OLD_SPACE_SIZE
entries.description: The --max-old-space-size option to use for a task runner (in MB). By default, Node.js will set this based on available memory.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_MAX_OLD_SPACE_SIZE
entries.description: The --max-old-space-size option to use for a task runner (in MB). By default, Node.js will set this based on available memory.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_MAX_PAYLOAD
entries.description: Maximum payload size in bytes for communication between a task broker and a task runner.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_MAX_PAYLOAD
entries.description: Maximum payload size in bytes for communication between a task broker and a task runner.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_MAX_PAYLOAD
entries.description: Maximum payload size in bytes for communication between a task broker and a task runner.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_MODE
entries.description: How to launch and run the task runner. internal means n8n will launch a task runner as child process. Deprecated: internal mode will be removed in a future version. external means an external orchestrator will launch the task runner. See external mode.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_STDLIB_ALLOW
entries.description: Python standard library modules that you can use in the Code node, including their submodules. Use * to allow all stdlib modules. n8n disables all Python standard library imports by default. In external mode, set this in the runners config file (/etc/n8n-task-runners.json) as an env-override, not as

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_TASK_BROKER_URI
entries.description: The URI of the task broker server (n8n instance).

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_TASK_BROKER_URI
entries.description: The URI of the task broker server (n8n instance).

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_TASK_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
entries.description: How long (in seconds) a task request can wait for a runner to become available before timing out. This prevents workflows from hanging indefinitely when no runners are available. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_RUNNERS_TASK_TIMEOUT
entries.description: The maximum time, in seconds, a task can run before the runner stops it and restarts. This value must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SAMESITE_COOKIE
entries.description:
Controls cross-site cookie behavior (learn more):
  • strict: Sent only for first-party requests.
  • lax (default): Sent with top-level navigation requests.
  • none: Sent in all contexts (requires HTTPS).

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_CLAIM_BATCH_SIZE
entries.description: The most runs a single claim takes from the queue in one pass. Larger batches drain a backlog faster but hold more work on one instance per tick. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_ENABLED
entries.description: Whether to use the durable scheduler. Defaults to true from n8n 2.45.0 (false in earlier versions). Set to false to use the in-memory scheduler. Requires N8N_USE_WORKFLOW_PUBLICATION_SERVICE, also on by default, to take over Schedule Trigger nodes. Deprecated from n8n 2.45.0: a future version will r

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_EXECUTOR_INTERVAL
entries.description: How often, in seconds, the scheduler checks for recorded runs coming due. Each check claims the runs due within the next interval and holds them on a precise timer, so a run starts at its scheduled instant rather than on the polling cadence. The interval caps how long the scheduler takes to pick up

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_EXECUTOR_TIMEOUT
entries.description: How long, in seconds, a single check for due runs may run before it's abandoned and retried on the next interval. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_FAILED_RETENTION
entries.description: How long, in seconds, the scheduler keeps runs that went wrong (a failure, or a missed run) before deleting them. Defaults to seven days. Keep it longer than N8N_SCHEDULER_RETENTION so there's time to debug; the scheduler warns if you set it lower. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_JITTER_RATIO
entries.description: A small random variation added to the timing of each periodic pass, as a fraction of the interval. With 0.1, a pass set to run every 10 seconds actually runs every 9 to 11 seconds. This spreads out database queries from instances started at the same time, such as during a rolling deploy. Set it to 0

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_LEASE_DURATION
entries.description: How long, in seconds, an instance holds an exclusive claim on a run it picked up, so no other instance starts the same one. If the instance stops without finishing, the claim expires after this long and another instance may take over. Keep it comfortably above the time a run needs to get going: too

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_MATERIALIZATION_INTERVAL
entries.description: How often, in seconds, the scheduler scans active schedules to record the runs falling within the window. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_MATERIALIZATION_TIMEOUT
entries.description: How long, in seconds, a single scan may run before it's abandoned and retried on the next interval. Guards against a scan stuck on a slow database. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_MATERIALIZATION_WINDOW
entries.description: How far into the future, in seconds, the scheduler records upcoming runs. A larger window commits more runs in advance (more resilient to downtime, slightly more storage churn). Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_MAX_ATTEMPTS
entries.description: How many times a scheduled run may be reclaimed (for example after a crash) or retried on error before n8n gives up on it and dead-letters it. Raise it on infrastructure prone to instance restarts or transient errors; lower it to give up and move on sooner. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_MAX_CONCURRENT_PASSES
entries.description: The most background passes of the same kind that can run at once on one instance, when the database supports overlapping passes (PostgreSQL). If a pass comes due while the limit is already in use, n8n skips it. On SQLite, passes never overlap, so this setting has no effect. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_MISFIRE_GRACE
entries.description: How late, in seconds, a run may start and still count as on time. A run later than this counts as missed, and its trigger's misfire policy decides what happens to it and to any backlog behind it. This is the default a schedule inherits; from n8n 2.36.0, a Schedule Trigger node can set its own grace

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_OWNER_QUARANTINE_GRACE
entries.description: How long, in seconds, the sweep keeps a stopped schedule before deleting it. Defaults to one day. The schedule stops firing as soon as the sweep finds it, so this only delays the delete. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_OWNER_RECONCILIATION_BATCH_SIZE
entries.description: How many owners the sweep checks per database query. Larger batches finish a sweep in fewer queries; smaller ones keep each query light. Must be between 1 and 1000.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_OWNER_RECONCILIATION_ENABLED
entries.description: Whether the scheduler periodically checks that every schedule's owner still exists and retires the schedules whose owner is missing. Turning it off leaves those schedules in place.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_OWNER_RECONCILIATION_INTERVAL
entries.description: How often, in seconds, the sweep runs. Defaults to 15 minutes. It's a safety net rather than the usual cleanup path, so a long interval is fine. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_OWNER_RECONCILIATION_TIMEOUT
entries.description: How long, in seconds, a single sweep may run before it's abandoned and retried on the next interval. Defaults to five minutes. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_OWNER_SETTLE_PERIOD
entries.description: How old, in seconds, a schedule must be before the sweep considers it. Defaults to five minutes. n8n can write a schedule a moment before its owner, so this stops the sweep from mistaking a brand-new schedule for an abandoned one. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_POLL_TIMEOUT
entries.description: How long, in seconds, a single poll may run before n8n abandons it. An abandoned poll records nothing: the cursor stays put and the next poll covers the same ground, so no data goes missing. A poll that keeps timing out counts as failing, so n8n re-polls it at a widening interval. Keep the timeout b

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_POLL_TRIGGERS_ENABLED
entries.description: Whether the durable scheduler also takes over polling triggers (trigger nodes with a Poll Times parameter). Requires N8N_SCHEDULER_ENABLED and N8N_USE_WORKFLOW_PUBLICATION_SERVICE. Available from n8n 2.33.0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_REAPER_BATCH_SIZE
entries.description: The most expired-claim runs a single reaper pass reclaims. Larger batches recover a backlog faster but hold more work on one instance per pass. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_REAPER_INTERVAL
entries.description: How often, in seconds, the scheduler looks for runs an instance claimed but never finished (for example after a crash or shutdown) and makes them available again. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_REAPER_TIMEOUT
entries.description: How long, in seconds, a single recovery pass may run before it's abandoned and retried on the next interval. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_RETENTION
entries.description: How long, in seconds, the scheduler keeps runs that finished cleanly (a success or a cancellation) before deleting them. Defaults to one day. Raise it to keep more history, lower it to reclaim database space sooner. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_RETENTION_INTERVAL
entries.description: How often, in seconds, the scheduler deletes finished runs older than the retention windows. Defaults to one hour. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_RETENTION_TIMEOUT
entries.description: How long, in seconds, a single cleanup pass may run before it's abandoned and retried on the next interval. Defaults to five minutes. Must be greater than 0.

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_SYSTEM_TASKS_ENABLED
entries.description: Whether the durable scheduler runs n8n's internal maintenance jobs instead of the leader main's in-process timers. Requires N8N_SCHEDULER_ENABLED. Give every main the same value for both variables, and run the same n8n version on every main. A main with either flag off removes the durable schedules

entries.name: N8N_SCHEDULER_TRIGGER_NODE_MODE
entries.description: How a Schedule Trigger node's "every N seconds" and "every N minutes" schedules fire. new spaces runs a steady N apart from workflow publication. It's the default from n8n 2.45.0. legacy keeps clock-aligned timing matching the in-memory scheduler and is the default in earlier versions. Only affects

entries.name: N8N_SECURE_COOKIE
entries.description: Ensures that cookies are only sent over HTTPS, enhancing security.

entries.name: N8N_SECURITY_AUDIT_DAYS_ABANDONED_WORKFLOW
entries.description: Number of days to consider a workflow abandoned if it's not executed.

entries.name: N8N_SMTP_HOST
entries.description: _your_SMTP_server_name_

entries.name: N8N_SMTP_OAUTH_PRIVATE_KEY
entries.description: If using 2LO with a service account this is your private key

entries.name: N8N_SMTP_OAUTH_SERVICE_CLIENT
entries.description: If using 2LO with a service account this is your client ID

entries.name: N8N_SMTP_PASS
entries.description: _your_SMTP_password_

entries.name: N8N_SMTP_PORT
entries.description: _your_SMTP_server_port_

entries.name: N8N_SMTP_SENDER
entries.description: Sender email address. You can optionally include the sender name. Example with name: _n8n <contact@n8n.com>_

entries.name: N8N_SMTP_SSL
entries.description: Whether to use SSL for SMTP (true) or not (false).

entries.name: N8N_SMTP_STARTTLS
entries.description: Whether to use STARTTLS for SMTP (true) or not (false).

entries.name: N8N_SMTP_USER
entries.description: _your_SMTP_username_

entries.name: N8N_SOURCECONTROL_DEFAULT_SSH_KEY_TYPE
entries.description: Set to rsa to make RSA the default SSH key type for Source control setup.

entries.name: N8N_SSL_CERT
entries.description: The SSL certificate for HTTPS protocol.

entries.name: N8N_SSL_KEY
entries.description: The SSL key for HTTPS protocol.

entries.name: N8N_SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES
entries.description: Comma-separated hostnames to allow. Supports a leading *. wildcard: *.internal.example.com matches any subdomain, including nested ones, but not the bare domain. Matching is case-insensitive.

entries.name: N8N_SSRF_ALLOWED_IP_RANGES
entries.description: Comma-separated CIDR ranges to allow. Takes precedence over the block list, so use it to reach a known internal host.

entries.name: N8N_SSRF_BLOCKED_HOSTNAMES
entries.description: Comma-separated hostnames to deny by name, checked before DNS resolution. Uses the same leading *. wildcard and case-insensitive matching as N8N_SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES. An allowed hostname always overrides a blocked one.

entries.name: N8N_SSRF_BLOCKED_IP_RANGES
entries.description: Comma-separated CIDR ranges to block. The keyword default (case-insensitive) expands to n8n's built-in set. Append your own ranges: default,100.64.0.0/10.

entries.name: N8N_SSRF_DNS_CACHE_MAX_SIZE
entries.description: Maximum size of the internal DNS-resolution cache, in bytes (1 MB by default). n8n evicts the least recently used entries when the cache is full.

entries.name: N8N_SSRF_PROTECTION_ENABLED
entries.description: Turns on SSRF protection for requests to user-controllable targets.

entries.name: N8N_STORAGE_PATH
entries.description: Base path for filesystem storage. When N8N_EXECUTION_DATA_STORAGE_MODE is filesystem, n8n stores execution data here. n8n also uses this path for filesystem binary data.

entries.name: N8N_TEMPLATES_ENABLED
entries.description: Enables workflow templates[^1] (true) or disable (false).

entries.name: N8N_TEMPLATES_HOST
entries.description: Change this if creating your own workflow template library. Note that to use your own workflow templates library, your API must provide the same endpoints and response structure as n8n's. Refer to Workflow templates for more information.

entries.name: N8N_TUNNEL_SUBDOMAIN
entries.description: Specifies the subdomain for the n8n tunnel. If not set, n8n generates a random subdomain.

entries.name: N8N_UM_EMAIL_TEMPLATES_CREDENTIALS_SHARED
entries.description: Overrides the default HTML template for notifying users that a credential was shared. Provide the full path to the template.

entries.name: N8N_UM_EMAIL_TEMPLATES_INVITE
entries.description: Full path to your HTML email template. This overrides the default template for invite emails.

entries.name: N8N_UM_EMAIL_TEMPLATES_PROJECT_SHARED
entries.description: Overrides the default HTML template for notifying users that a project was shared. Provide the full path to the template.

entries.name: N8N_UM_EMAIL_TEMPLATES_PWRESET
entries.description: Full path to your HTML email template. This overrides the default template for password reset emails.

entries.name: N8N_UM_EMAIL_TEMPLATES_WORKFLOW_SHARED
entries.description: Overrides the default HTML template for notifying users that a workflow was shared. Provide the full path to the template.

entries.name: N8N_UNVERIFIED_PACKAGES_ENABLED
entries.description: When N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_ENABLED is true, this variable controls whether to enable the installation and use of unverified community nodes from an NPM registry (true) or not (false).

entries.name: N8N_USER_FOLDER
entries.description: Provide the path where n8n will create the .n8n folder. This directory stores user-specific data, such as database file and encryption key.

entries.name: N8N_USER_MANAGEMENT_JWT_DURATION_HOURS
entries.description: Set an expiration date for the JWTs in hours.

entries.name: N8N_USER_MANAGEMENT_JWT_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_HOURS
entries.description: How many hours before the JWT expires to automatically refresh it. 0 means 25% of N8N_USER_MANAGEMENT_JWT_DURATION_HOURS. -1 means it will never refresh, which forces users to log in again after the period defined in N8N_USER_MANAGEMENT_JWT_DURATION_HOURS.

entries.name: N8N_USER_MANAGEMENT_JWT_SECRET
entries.description: Set a specific JWT secret. By default, n8n generates one on start.

entries.name: N8N_VERIFIED_PACKAGES_ENABLED
entries.description: When N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_ENABLED is true, this variable controls whether to show verified community nodes in the nodes panel for installation and use (true) or to hide them (false).

entries.name: N8N_VERSION_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED
entries.description: When enabled, n8n sends notifications of new versions and security updates.

entries.name: N8N_VERSION_NOTIFICATIONS_ENDPOINT
entries.description: The endpoint to retrieve where version information.

entries.name: N8N_VERSION_NOTIFICATIONS_INFO_URL
entries.description: The URL displayed in the New Versions panel for more information.

entries.name: N8N_WEBHOOK_RESPONSE_RELAY_OFFLOAD_ENABLED
entries.description: Whether a worker stores a response body above N8N_WEBHOOK_RESPONSE_RELAY_SIZE_MAX in binary data storage, so the main instance can stream it to the client, instead of failing the node. Needs a N8N_DEFAULT_BINARY_DATA_MODE that stores (filesystem, database, s3, or azure), and storage every instance c

entries.name: N8N_WEBHOOK_RESPONSE_RELAY_SIZE_MAX
entries.description: Maximum size (in MiB) of a response a worker sends back to the main instance inside a queue message. Redis holds several copies of a response in flight, so budget about 1.5 times this value in Redis memory per response in flight. The same limit applies to a tool result an MCP Trigger workflow return

entries.name: N8N_WEBHOOK_URL
entries.description: Sets the base URL for both test and production webhooks when running n8n behind a reverse proxy. Use this instead of the N8N_ENDPOINT_* variables above, which set only the endpoint _path_, not a URL. See Configure webhook URLs with reverse proxy.

entries.name: N8N_WORKFLOW_ACTIVATION_BATCH_SIZE
entries.description: How many workflows to publish simultaneously during startup.

entries.name: N8N_WORKFLOW_AUTODEACTIVATION_ENABLED
entries.description: Whether workflows are automatically unpublished after repeated crashed executions.

entries.name: N8N_WORKFLOW_AUTODEACTIVATION_MAX_LAST_EXECUTIONS
entries.description: Number of crashed executions before unpublishing a workflow.

entries.name: N8N_WORKFLOW_CALLER_POLICY_DEFAULT_OPTION
entries.description: Which workflows can call a workflow. Options are: any, none, workflowsFromAList, workflowsFromSameOwner. This feature requires Workflow sharing.

entries.name: N8N_WORKFLOW_HISTORY_PRUNE_TIME
entries.description: How long to keep workflow history versions before automatically deleting them (in hours). Set to -1 to keep all versions indefinitely.

entries.name: N8N_WORKFLOW_TAGS_DISABLED
entries.description: Whether to disable workflow tags (true) or enable tags (false).

entries.name: NODES_ERROR_TRIGGER_TYPE
entries.description: Specify which node type to use as Error Trigger.

entries.name: NODES_EXCLUDE
entries.description: Specify which nodes not to load. For example, to block nodes that can be a security risk if users aren't trustworthy: NODES_EXCLUDE: "[\"n8n-nodes-base.executeCommand\", \"@n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.lmChatDeepSeek\"]". To enable all nodes, specify NODES_EXCLUDE: "[]".

entries.name: NODES_INCLUDE
entries.description: Specify which nodes to load.

entries.name: NODES_MERGE_SQL_SANDBOX_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB
entries.description: Memory limit in MB for the Merge node's SQL sandbox. Increase this if Combine by SQL fails with large datasets and your instance has enough memory available.

entries.name: NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN
entries.description: Permit users to import specific built-in modules in the Code node. Use * to allow all. n8n disables importing modules by default.

entries.name: NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN
entries.description: Permit users to import specific built-in modules in the Code node. Use * to allow all. n8n disables importing modules by default. In external mode, set this in the runners config file (/etc/n8n-task-runners.json) as an env-override, not as a container environment variable.

entries.name: NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_EXTERNAL
entries.description: Permit users to import specific external modules (from n8n/node_modules) in the Code node. n8n disables importing modules by default.

entries.name: NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_EXTERNAL
entries.description: Permit users to import specific external modules (from n8n/node_modules) in the Code node. n8n disables importing modules by default. In external mode, set this in the runners config file (/etc/n8n-task-runners.json) as an env-override, not as a container environment variable.

entries.name: NODE_OPTIONS
entries.description: Options for Node.js.

entries.name: NO_COLOR
entries.description: Set to any value to output logs without ANSI colors. For more information, see the no-color.org website.

entries.name: NO_PROXY
entries.description: A comma-separated list of hostnames or URLs that should bypass the proxy. When using HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, or ALL_PROXY, n8n will connect directly to the URLs or hostnames defined here instead of using the proxy.

entries.name: OFFLOAD_MANUAL_EXECUTIONS_TO_WORKERS
entries.description: Set to true if you want manual executions to run on the worker rather than on main.

entries.name: OTEL_PROPAGATORS
entries.description: Comma-separated list naming which headers n8n writes while N8N_OTEL_TRACES_INJECT_OUTBOUND is true. Valid names: tracecontext (sends traceparent and tracestate), baggage, and none. Set it to tracecontext to stop n8n forwarding the caller's baggage entries downstream. n8n reads it once at startup, so

entries.name: QUEUE_BULL_PREFIX
entries.description: Prefix to use for all queue keys.

entries.name: QUEUE_BULL_REDIS_CLUSTER_NODES
entries.description: Expects a comma-separated list of Redis Cluster nodes in the format host:port, for the Redis client to initially connect to. If running in queue mode (EXECUTIONS_MODE = queue), setting this variable will create a Redis Cluster client instead of a Redis client, and n8n will ignore QUEUE_BULL_REDIS_HO

entries.name: QUEUE_BULL_REDIS_DB
entries.description: The Redis database used.

entries.name: QUEUE_BULL_REDIS_DUALSTACK
entries.description: Enable dual-stack support (IPv4 and IPv6) on Redis connections.

entries.name: QUEUE_BULL_REDIS_HOST
entries.description: The Redis host.

entries.name: QUEUE_BULL_REDIS_PASSWORD
entries.description: The Redis password.

entries.name: QUEUE_BULL_REDIS_PORT
entries.description: The Redis port used.

entries.name: QUEUE_BULL_REDIS_TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD
entries.description: The Redis timeout threshold (in ms).

entries.name: QUEUE_BULL_REDIS_TLS
entries.description: Enable TLS on Redis connections.

entries.name: QUEUE_BULL_REDIS_USERNAME
entries.description: The Redis username (needs Redis version 6 or above). Don't define it for Redis < 6 compatibility

entries.name: QUEUE_HEALTH_CHECK_ACTIVE
entries.description: Whether to enable health checks (true) or disable (false).

entries.name: QUEUE_HEALTH_CHECK_PORT
entries.description: The port to serve health checks on. If you experience a port conflict error when starting a worker server using its default port, change this.

entries.name: QUEUE_WORKER_LOCK_DURATION
entries.description: How long (in ms) is the lease period for a worker to work on a message.

entries.name: QUEUE_WORKER_LOCK_RENEW_TIME
entries.description: How frequently (in ms) should a worker renew the lease time.

entries.name: QUEUE_WORKER_STALLED_INTERVAL
entries.description: How often should a worker check for stalled jobs (use 0 for never).

entries.name: VUE_APP_URL_BASE_API
entries.description: Used when building the n8n-editor-ui package manually to set how the frontend can reach the backend API. Refer to Configure the Base URL.

entries.name: WEBHOOK_URL
entries.description: Deprecated from n8n 2.35.0; alias of N8N_WEBHOOK_URL. Still works, but n8n logs a deprecation warning on startup.

entries.name: WORKFLOWS_DEFAULT_NAME
entries.description: The default name used for new workflows.
